description: This file contains unit tests for the SudoRetrieveThingStrategy class, which is part of the command strategy pattern used in the Eclipse Ditto project for managing 'thing' retrieval commands. It verifies behavior such as immutability, definition checks, and retrieval results with various parameters.

classes.name: SudoRetrieveThingStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the SudoRetrieveThingStrategy component, testing its immutability, definition logic, and retrieval behaviors under various scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating an instance of SudoRetrieveThingStrategy before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of SudoRetrieveThingStrategy are immutable.

methods.name: isNotDefinedForDeviantThingIds
methods.description: Tests that the strategy correctly reports undefined for invalid or deviant thing IDs.

methods.name: isNotDefinedIfContextHasNoThing
methods.description: Checks that the strategy is undefined when the context has no associated 'thing'.

methods.name: isDefinedIfContextHasThingAndThingIdsAreEqual
methods.description: Ensures the strategy is defined when the context's 'thing' ID matches the command's 'thing' ID.

methods.name: retrieveThingWithoutSelectedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a 'thing' without specifying particular fields, expecting full object response.

methods.name: retrieveThingWithoutSelectedFieldsWithOriginalSchemaVersion
methods.description: Tests retrieval using the original schema version with no specific fields selected.

methods.name: retrieveThingWithSelectedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a 'thing' with specific fields selected.

methods.name: retrieveThingWithSelectedFieldsWithOriginalSchemaVersion
methods.description: Tests retrieval with selected fields using the original schema version.

methods.name: unhandledReturnsThingNotAccessibleException
methods.description: Verifies that an unhandled scenario results in a ThingNotAccessibleException.
